title: Proofline Suppression Record
description: Minimal record kept indefinitely, because it is necessary to honour an objection (GDPR Art. 21). Never used as a target list, never exported to campaign tools.

source.description: how the objection reached us (reply, unsubscribe link, request)

review_on.description: optional: date to re-confirm the record is still needed; suppression itself is not time-limited
